title: Existence and Uniqueness of Normalized Multi-peak Solutions for Coupled Nonlinear Schrödinger Systems
summary: We consider the following two-component coupled nonlinear Schrödinger (CNLS) system: \[ \begin{cases} -Δu +(P(x) + λ) u=μ_1 u^3+βu v^2, & \text{in } \mathbb{R}^N,\\ -Δv +(Q(x) + λ) v =μ_2 v^3+βvu^2, & \text{in } \mathbb{R}^N \end{cases} \] with the mass constraint $\int_{\mathbb{R}^N} (u^2+v^2)\,dx = ρ^2$ for $N=2,3$, where $ρ>0$ is a parameter.
